# CHAPTER XVOf Religion by Attaining the Supreme

Krishna. Men call the Aswattha,- the Banyan-tree,-Which hath its boughs beneath, its roots above,-The ever-holy tree. Yea! for its leavesAre green and waving hymns which whisper Truth!
